##### Project general facts

Riviera 60 by Azizi Developments is a residential building in a Mediterranean architectural style, distinguished by stained-glass details and elegant facades. Balconies, generous glazing and a warm palette give the building a welcoming, refined character within a waterfront community. It rises above two basement levels and a ground floor to eight residential floors and a roof, offering studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments together with commercial units at street level.

Residents enjoy swimming pools for adults and children with a poolside terrace, a fitness centre, a yoga studio and a lounge for everyday wellness and relaxation. Tennis and basketball courts, jogging and cycling tracks, landscaped parks with barbecue areas and an indoor children's play area add variety, while access to the community beach, a pedestrian avenue with retail and dining, valet parking and round-the-clock security complete the offer.

Interiors are finished with premium materials such as Italian marble flooring and high-quality wooden details, creating elegant and comfortable living spaces. Efficient layouts, large windows and balconies bring natural light deep into each home. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and built-in appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and making each apartment easy to personalise.

##### Location description and benefits

Azizi Riviera is a large waterfront community within Meydan One in Mohammed Bin Rashid City, inspired by the French Riviera and built around a crystal lagoon. A long boulevard lined with cafes, boutiques, supermarkets and restaurants, landscaped parks, walking paths and a lagoon beach create a lively yet relaxed setting, with everyday needs within walking distance of every building.

Al Khail Road and Meydan Road connect residents with the wider city. The Meydan Hotel and Meydan Racecourse are close by, Downtown Dubai, The Dubai Mall and Business Bay are a short drive away, and Dubai Design District, Dubai Festival City, the Dubai World Trade Centre and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable driving distance for work, leisure and travel.

Azizi Riviera is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the most popular mid-market waterfront addresses close to Downtown Dubai. Lagoon views, integrated retail and an established, fully serviced community attract professionals and families, supporting steady rental demand. Competitive prices and a central location underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners and investors.
